title: Fantasy Texture Concept Update 1.21.4+
description: Fantasy Texture Pack from legacy console updated to newer versions.
body:
Fantasy Texture Concept Update 1.21.4+ is a Unofficial Continuation resource pack of the Fantasy Texture Pack by 4J Studios, the original pack have been discontinued since Bundles of Bravery, This resource pack changes the look of the newer blocks, items and mobs of what if the Fantasy Texture Pack continued updating after Bundles of Bravery? This is supposed to work with the overlay of the Fantasy Texture Pack and will NOT work properly without it.
![Fantasy Texture Pack Support for Newer Versions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e64c3eede4c37d8b39f0bebcb47a07a8f4a0f5d7_0.webp)
